title: SDK triage: unify auth deadline handling, stabilize stream signals and small ergonomic shims
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Backported auth deadline handling across SDKs; streaming signal stabilization; minor ergonomic helpers and version bumps (py 1.7.0, ts 2.4.1, go v0.9.8). No API surface break for most users; recommend patch bump for embedded clients.
description:
Context: Several customers and internal tests exposed subtle race conditions between per-request auth token refresh deadlines and streaming connection lifecycle across all three official SDKs. In parallel, streaming consumers reported rare stalls when the internal stream signal (heartbeat/ping) overlapped connection backpressure events. This PR consolidates the pragmatic fixes across Python/TS/Go, improves developer ergonomics for stream iteration, and bumps SDK package versions.

What changed (high level):
1) Auth/shutdown: normalize how per-request deadlines are derived from user context and client-level token refresh windows. SDKs now treat refresh window as a soft deadline and attach a conservative cancel deadline to long-lived stream dial operations to prevent leaked goroutines/threads.
2) Retries: unify the outgoing retry metadata header (X-Redwood-Retry-Meta) so the gateway can make consistent decisions across SDKs; this was a behavioral mismatch causing different retry counts during auth timeout.
3) Streaming signals: add a lightweight Stream.Signal heartbeat and explicit Drain signal to make consumer backpressure + server idle-detection deterministic.
4) Ergonomic shims: Python gets a generator wrapper (Stream.iter_chunks()) that yields typed events and hides reconnection logic; TypeScript adds an AsyncIterable shim that mirrors the Python ergonomics; Go exposes a Stream.NextWithContext(ctx) helper to avoid subtle cancellation races.
5) Version bumps: python -> 1.7.0, typescript -> 2.4.1, go -> v0.9.8.

Commits summary:
- normalize/auth-deadline: unify deadline derivation across SDKs
- stream/signal: heartbeat and drain primitives, tests
- sdk/python: iterator shim + docs + tests
- sdk/ts: async iterable shim + types + tests
- sdk/go: context-aware Next helper + pool backoff fix
- ci: add flaky streaming integration retry in pipeline

Files changed (high level):
- sdk/python/redwood_sdk/transport/stream.py
- sdk/python/redwood_sdk/auth.py
- sdk/python/CHANGELOG.md
- sdk/typescript/src/stream/async_iterable_shim.ts
- sdk/typescript/src/auth/token_manager.ts
- sdk/typescript/package.json
- sdk/go/stream/stream.go
- sdk/go/auth/token.go
- sdk/go/internal/pool/backoff.go
- integration-tests/streaming/stream_stability_test.go
- ci/pipelines/streaming-integration.yml

Tests and CI: Initial runs showed a flaky failure in the TS integration test (race between token refresh and reconnect). Added an exponential backoff and a short jitter in the pipeline to reduce flakiness; subsequent runs passed. Unit and integration test matrix: python unit/integration (pass), ts unit/pass integration/pass (after retry), go unit/pass integration/pass.

Review thread (condensed):
- Diego Rivera (request changes): "The Go change looks sensible but the context cancelation path needs explicit test coverage; I've seen panics if ctx is already cancelled when NextWithContext is called."
- Asha Patel (author): "Added TestNextWithContextCancelled and a nil-check; expanded comments explaining ownership of ctx in README."
- Maya Chen (request changes): "TS shim should not swallow structured 'error' events coming from the server; prefer yielding an ErrorEvent object rather than throwing for stream consumers."
- Asha Patel: "Updated shim to yield ErrorEvent objects with an explicit .fatal boolean for consumers to decide; added docs and example code snippet."
- Liam O'Connor (approved): "Looks good; small nit on comment wording in python iterator but not blocking."

Merge outcome: CI green, approvals from Liam and Diego after followups, merged by squash with message "sdk: unify auth deadline and stabilize streaming signals across SDKs (py/ts/go)".

Notes and followups:
- Follow-up task ENG-1499 to audit SDK telemetry during auth deadline drops (we now emit retry metadata but need to ensure tracing correlates correctly).
- UX: consider adding high-level Streams guide to docs site describing signals and ergonomics (doc ticket PM-231).
- Backport: small auth deadline logic flagged for cherry-pick to release/1.6.x for customers on older pinned versions.
